summary: HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund L.P., a Delaware private fund advised by HarbourVest Partners, filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered continuous private placement of limited partnership units. On September 1, 2026 the Fund sold 179,198 Class I Units for approximately $2.15 million to accredited investors and qualified purchasers under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D; unit counts were finalized September 29, 2026 using August 31, 2026 Transactional NAVs. The broader HSEC Fund Complex issued roughly $79.3 million of interests. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or change-of-control mechanics apply; watch for ongoing NAV pricing and capital-raise cadence.
